pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json
pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-core test -- editor live-preview

However, this PR cannot be accepted in its current state because of the following blocking issues:

1. CLA is not signed yet. The CLA bot reports that 0 out of 2 committers have signed:

```text

```

2. The PR title does not follow the repository Conventional Commits requirement. Current title:

```text

```

Please use a valid conventional title, for example:

```text
fix(core): eliminate unsafe any casts in live preview modules
```

Closing this PR for now. Please complete the CLA and submit/reopen with a compliant title.
